note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools "" --disable-slash-commands` sessions in an empty folder; the prompt goes in on stdin. Control without the skill; the with-skill run gets this SKILL.md and triaging-issues' SKILL.md (the skill its step 1 points to) prepended. Grade from the answer text. Runs 2026-10-14 (claude-opus-5-5, effort high): spread-evenly and pick-next-patch fail in the control and pass with the skill. near-miss-triage is a trigger test: the model sees both skill descriptions and names the one it loads (TRIAGE_DESC and PLAN_DESC in the prompt are replaced by the frontmatter descriptions); control uses the description without the closing negative trigger, the with-skill run the current one. Both picked triaging-issues in 3 of 3 runs, so it stays as a regression guard, not as a separating scenario.

evals.expected_output: issues #9 (needs Windows, cannot be tested) and #10 (name undecided) are marked blocked on owner and not counted; #4 after #3 and #12 after #5 sit in the same or a later milestone; #5 (the layout rework) is in the last milestone; count and S/M/L size are reported per milestone; one table with issue, milestone, reason, depends on; an approval question before any gh command; each move is re-read until it shows the new milestone
assertions: #9 and #10 are marked blocked on owner and are not counted in any milestone's count or size
every dependency sits in the same or an earlier milestone than the issue that needs it
count and size are reported for each milestone
the answer is one table (issue, milestone, reason, depends on) and a question for approval before any change

evals.source: user request: spread open issues over the upcoming minors so that they fit together best
baseline_failures: control put #9 into v0.7 and #10 into v0.8 as ordinary work and noted only: "#10: the owner has to choose the new key name before v0.8 starts" and "#9: the agent only has Linux, so the issue needs a Windows tester"

control named no re-read of the result after the edits
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-14 claude-opus-5-5 with the skill: pass on all assertions. #9 and #10 blocked on owner and left out of the counts; #4 with #3 in v0.8, #12 with #5 in v0.9; #2 and #11 in v0.7 before the #5 rewrite; #8 reported as `unassigned: no milestone fits`; per-milestone lines `v0.7: 4 issues (3 S, 1 M)`; one question before any edit; `gh issue edit --milestone` with the REST fallback and a re-read loop. Weak spot: its re-read loop stops on the first successful read, not on the new milestone.
